preparationNotes: Discharge deals normal damage and brands the target with a Storm instead of a burst — a damage-over-time debuff worth 6× your attack over its base 4.5s, extended +1s by each normal attack (up to 7.5s, adding more total damage). Near-permanent uptime even with a slow weapon; discharges refresh it.
Mature reachable biome caps; +5 where authored upgrades permit; full owner HP/barrier; production fresh summons; no rites.
Ordered abilities use production triggers. Only declared target-casting Brace replaces its low-HP default.
Historical starting point: package-fit-r1 balanced reference; frame/path changes are new packages, not historical reuses.
Fixed cadence, attack bonus, or long-lived Attack-scaled DoT makes high base Attack credible despite slow weapon cadence.
Relic relic-colossus-heart: concentrated potency; accepts frequency/reconstruction penalty.
slam has first offensive priority; high Attack supports direct AoE burst.
Offensive stance is always active; no stance switching.
Unused RP is deliberate bounded-package headroom, not a claim of optimal allocation.
